name: shariff-plus
description: Shariff-Plus enables website users to share or like their favorite content without compromising their privacy. It is based on Shariff by Heise Medien GmbH & Co. KG.

scripts.dev: npm run -s build && npm run -s copy_demo && lessc demo/app.less demo/app.css && npx http-server -p 3000 demo/
scripts.compile_less: lessc --modify-var='fa-font-path=.' src/style/shariff-complete.less dist/shariff.complete.css && lessc src/style/shariff.less dist/shariff.min.css && lessc src/style/dialogs/facebooklike_dlg.less dist/facebooklike_dlg.css
scripts.copy_demo: rm -f demo/*.css && rm -f demo/*.js && rm -f demo/*.ttf && rm -f demo/*.woff2 && cp dist/*.* demo/
scripts.build: rm -fr dist && mkdir dist && npm run -s compile_less && npm run -s compile_js && npm run -s copy_fonts
